explanation: Katsushika Hokusai was born in Edo, the old name for Tokyo, in 1760. He made The Great Wave around 1831, at about 70, and worked on into his late eighties.

claims.text: Katsushika Hokusai was born in 1760 in Edo (Tokyo).
The United States Declaration of Independence was adopted in 1776.
Hokusai made The Great Wave off Kanagawa around 1831, when he was about 70.
Hokusai kept working until he died in 1849, in his late eighties.
